result.title: Generative World Simulation with DAO and JING
result.comment: XGEN DAO and JING Technical report. Contributors listed alphabetically by surname. Project page: https://xgenlabs.ai/research/generative-world-simulation; Model: https://huggingface.co/XGENlabs/XGEN-JING
result.summary: We present a Generative World Simulation framework that couples persistent shared world state with continuous first-person audiovisual generation. The framework integrates DAO, a computable world engine, and JING, an Egocentric Interactive Experience Model, to support sustained interaction for humans and agents. DAO maintains the states of characters, objects, and spaces and their relationships, advancing the world according to interaction rules and world time while preserving the consequences of past actions. From this evolving state, DAO derives observer-specific conditions for JING, which combines these conditions with character, object, and scene references, observation history, and current actions to generate each observer's audiovisual experience. Users can explore environments, manipulate objects, and communicate with characters through viewpoint control and text instructions, with their actions shaping both the shared state and subsequent experiences. By connecting world-state evolution with experience generation in a continuous interaction loop, the framework offers an approach to building interactive worlds that retain their history, evolve through action, and persist beyond any individual observer.

AI.brief_summary: 提出生成式世界模拟框架，将可计算世界引擎 DAO（维护角色、物体、空间的状态与关系，并按交互规则和世界时间推进、保留过往动作后果）与自我中心交互体验模型 JING（据观察者特定条件结合引用、观察历史与当前动作生成视听体验）耦合，形成持续交互循环。
AI.relevance_reason: DAO 以显式持久状态承载历史并派生观察者特定条件，其「状态维护—条件派生—生成」结构可能与 LVR 中循环/并行推理的状态更新、证据筛选与条件化生成形成类比，可供核查；但该工作属世界模型与视听生成系统，联系较间接。
